نترايق (form VI)
# نَتَرَايَقُ (natarāyaqu) /na.ta.raː.ja.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَرَايَقَ (tarāyaqa)
# نُتَرَايَقُ (nutarāyaqu) /nu.ta.raː.ja.qu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَرَايَقَ (tarāyaqa)
# نَتَرَايَقَ (natarāyaqa) /na.ta.raː.ja.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَرَايَقَ (tarāyaqa)
# نُتَرَايَقَ (nutarāyaqa) /nu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
